Once home to the famous assassin [[Vizu]], inhabitants of this neighborhood successfully petitioned the [[Celestial Ministry]] in the [[Timeline|year 1396]] to rename it in honor of the woman who had helped bring down [[Shiro Tagachi|Shiro the Betrayer]].
}}

==Getting there==
* The primary quest [[Mayhem in the Market]] leads Factions [[character]]s here.

* Non-Factions characters are able to gain access to this outpost after having completed [[Zen Daijun]] by being in a [[party]] with a Factions character while they complete the quest [[Mayhem in the Market]] - the entrance will otherwise be blocked to non-Factions characters.
